checks.description: activation: DefensiveMode.CounterBattery is the new branch, fed by the side-scoped ShellingReports registry. Until now CounterBatteryLogic was reachable only from AttackBaseMode, and the Attack doctrine ran for zero seconds of a 1,400-second match (no assault.* id appears anywhere in the trace), so the rule was correct and unreachable. An absent id means the screen still never walked at a gun it could not see.

outcome: the direct measure. msam killed 28 of this side's 82 losses, 17,400 credits, 47% of everything lost, and took ZERO damage in return across the whole match: every msam row in the engagement matrix reads damageDealt 0. Value killed was 11,920 against a prior median of 45,400. If riflemen now close on the guns instead of holding position, this is where it shows.

outcome: valueExchange scored 0.1595 of a 2.0 reference and is the heaviest fitness component at weight 0.25. The ratio was 0.319 against a prior median of 0.947. Killing a 900-credit rocket launcher with 100-credit riflemen is the single best trade available on this field, and e1 already returns 105 credits per kill.

invariant: this rule walks defenders off their post, which is the failure mode it is one step away from. It fires only when the unit has nothing at all inside its own leash, the target must be within 12 cells of the unit itself, and the allowance is 24 evaluations for a unit's entire life and is never refilled by a doctrine switch. Losses were 37,400 credits; a screen that marched into the enemy army would blow through this ceiling.

outcome: 18 buildings were lost and 1 was left standing, 28 of the losses to artillery that was never touched. Production died with them: the barracks at 602s, the airstrip at 668s, after which the side ordered 141 credits of anything in 732 remaining seconds. Buildings lost is the cleanest proxy for whether the siege was answered at all.

outcome: earnings froze at 24,270 credits from 600s and 791 seconds of a 1,400-second match had no live harvester, because msam killed six of nine harvesters and then the airstrip, leaving no queue that could replace them. 17.3 credits a second against a reference of 50 and a prior median of 32.9. A base that answers the guns keeps the fleet that pays for it.

outcome: fitness was 0.247 against a prior median of 0.504, with valueExchange 0.16, armyValueIntegral 0.06 and buildingsDestroyed 0.00 the three components at the floor. All three are downstream of an unanswered siege, so a working counter-battery should lift the total back to the median rather than one component.
